# Municipal Ordinance No. 06, Series of 2019

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 06**

*Isang Kautusang Bayan na Magtatakda ng mga Patakaran upang Mabigyan ng Daloy ng Tubig ang mga Tirahan/Tahanan ng mga Makikinabang na Mamamayan (Beneficiary) sa Bayan ng Pitogo, Lalawigan ng Quezon*

An ordinance prescribing policies to provide water supply flow to beneficiary households in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]].

## Summary

Enacted on November 11, 2019, this ordinance establishes policies for providing water supply access to beneficiary households in [[Pitogo]]. The measure recognizes that many residents, especially poor families, lack access to running water. Under this ordinance, property owners are required to allow water supply pipes to pass through their land without requiring permission fees from beneficiaries seeking water access. The ordinance was motioned by Councilor [[Benedicta M. Lozada]] with co-authors Councilors [[Carlo L. Jaranilla]] and [[Esperanza A. Tan]]. This is a complementary measure to [[MO-01-S2019]], which prescribes similar policies for electricity supply. Councilor [[Esperanza A. Tan]] was absent (O.B.) during the session.

## Key Provisions

- **Declaration of Policy.** Recognizes the need to provide water supply access to poor and underserved families in [[Pitogo]] who lack running water.
- **Right of Way for Water Pipes.** Property owners are required to allow water flow pipes to pass through their land to connect beneficiary households to the water supply system.
- **No Permission Fees.** Property owners may not charge permission fees or other costs for allowing water pipes through their property.
- **Beneficiary Coverage.** Applies to eligible beneficiary households (makikinabang na mamamayan) as identified by the municipal government.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
